meta.title: 오림 공방
meta.reviewed: Written by hand from source/BRIEF.md (오림 공방, a New Year class in cutting patterns from folded hanji (fictional workshop)). Every decision below follows the brief and the style it names; nothing is a preset.

source.notes: 오림 공방, a New Year class in cutting patterns from folded hanji (fictional workshop)
Korean OFL fonts, cut to the characters the reel shows

rationale.palette: Coloured hanji on a cream sheet #F1E9DA with fibres: festive red #C8372D for the main pattern, indigo #2E4677, pink #E06C8A and green #4E8F5A for the others, ink brown #3A2A22 for type; at night the red glows over a warm lamp #FFE296.
rationale.type: Song Myung, a brushed serif, for the name and the line; Gowun Dodum, round and friendly, for the step labels.
rationale.motion: The craft is the motion: three folds on the beat, each flap swinging over its crease and showing its back; scissors opening and closing along every outline with the piece falling away; the unfold, crease by crease, as the camera pulls back so the pattern blooms at once; finished sheets turn a little on the table.
rationale.sound: Bright pop at 112 BPM in G major on a pentatonic scale (0 2 4 7 9) with recorded instruments (VCSL, CC0): a plucked zither (dan tranh) like a gayageum carries the arpeggios over a soft pad, recorded glockenspiel on top and a flute hook; paper flips for the folds, scissor snips for the cuts, a sparkle as the pattern opens.
rationale.visuals: All code: a pattern is a set of holes in one eighth of the square, cut eight times by the square's symmetries into a cached sheet; folding is the reverse of unfolding, each flap being the sheet clipped to a half, quarter or eighth and squashed across its crease by cos θ (a reflection when folded); a shadow pass draws the same regions blurred and black.
rationale.narration: Not recommended: the paper shows it.
